protocol.selection: Locked before any generation: four distinct reference processes with at least 35 tasks, 8 gateways and 6 roles; no failed-case replacement
protocol.documents: Identical input business XML for both versions. Final saved human observation states retain only final documents; corpus references retain all source documents.
protocol.cpu_pinning: First three pairs use the same CPU per pair; final pair is run concurrently: baseline CPU0, new CPU1 after CPU0 became idle.
protocol.version_order: First three pairs as initially scheduled; final baseline starts while final new run is active, before either final-pair result is known.
protocol.note: Standard desktop algorithm settings. Full work is not equal: v23.9 fully refines two candidates. No causal ablation or speedup claim. Human references are descriptive targets, not a calibrated scalar similarity score. Failure rate remains part of the comparison.
protocol.scheduler_amendment: The final baseline was moved to idle CPU0 to avoid serial waiting. Original launcher is stopped after its final new run is recorded; any queued duplicate final baseline is cancelled before it can publish output. All eight official runs retain identical inputs and algorithm settings.
